protocol.baseline_comparison: Historical v1.3 out-of-fold heads on scored folds; never all-seven refit.
protocol.dead_head: Frozen v1.3 dead weights; WOH/WOY used in its historical training and never scored.
protocol.exposure: All seven Sportec matches previously exposed. Development CV only, not an untouched test.
protocol.independent_audit_policy: A separate Game2/provider audit may compare only frozen selected candidate vs baseline after selection; it must not tune, select a runner-up, or silently trigger retraining.
protocol.inner_gate_policy: Within each outer training set, lexicographically first match is held out; fit inner control and temporal experts on remaining matches, then gate on this inner match. Refit outer experts on all outer training matches.
protocol.refit: Freeze selection before all-seven refit; final artifact itself has no Sportec holdout.
protocol.selection: Rank eligible candidates by primary-condition equal-cell spell F1, then macro F1, then name; baseline fallback.
protocol.target_calibration: Unlabeled aggregate tracking/homography profile; no target possession labels, frame-geometry publication, or event labels.

release_decision.reason: Promoted gated-temporal after passing the fixed development gates and one-shot sparse independent audit.
